segments.text: Your Twitter bookmarks are a black hole.
Thousands of saved tweets you never look at again. Siftly fixes that. It's a local first bookmark organizer built in Typescript that uses AI to automatically
categorize and tag every saved tweet, then generates gorgeous interactive mindmap visualizations so you can actually explore your saved knowledge
visually. Your data stays local. Your chaos gets structured.
